subject: need to make a DNACopy object

messages.author: fd4715fb69ad2c08
messages.subject: need to make a DNACopy object
parts:
Hi,

this is a newbee question. I'm planning an analysis of a set of
Affymetrix SNP 6.0 arrays, and aroma.affymetrix looks like an
attractive option. However, I need to get a DNACopy object at the end
of my analysis, because I'd like to use another package that takes a
DNACopy object as its input. If I run CBS in aroma.affymetrix, can I
get that, or is there a way to convert the aroma.affymetrix output to
a DNACopy object?

Thanks.

Yury

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8

On Thu, May 29, 2008 at 3:48 PM, Yury Bukhman <ybuk...@hotmail.com> wrote:
>
> Hi,
>
> this is a newbee question. I'm planning an analysis of a set of
> Affymetrix SNP 6.0 arrays, and aroma.affymetrix looks like an
> attractive option. However, I need to get a DNACopy object at the end
> of my analysis, because I'd like to use another package that takes a
> DNACopy object as its input. If I run CBS in aroma.affymetrix, can I
> get that, or is there a way to convert the aroma.affymetrix output to
> a DNACopy object?

Use fits <- fit(cbs, ..., .retResults=TRUE) where 'cbs' is a CbsModel.
That will return a nested list of fitted object (here from
DNAcopy::segment()) where the first level is samples and second is
chromosome, i.e. onFit <- res[[arrayName]][[chr]].

If you call fit() twice it will find the results on file the 2nd call.

Cheers

Henrik
